<chrname> was going to be 
interviewed by 
Monthly Twinkle.

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
I see! So you intend to wear that same racing outfit 
when you take on the Arc de Triomphe 
as well...?!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
<chrname> running across 
the turf at Longchamp...! 
I can picture it already...!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Oh! So you too, Trainer, are certain 
she'll take the Arc de Triomphe 
by storm...?!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
And you can already see <chrname> 
holding the trophy aloft 
on the podium too...?!?!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
This is exactly the mindset a trainer needs 
to challenge the very summit of the world! 
I am thoroughly impressed...!!

That's right--<chrname> and I 
are about to take on a grand dream--

I have to hold on to the vision: we're strong enough 
to win the Arc de Triomphe...!

Following her example, I resolved to picture 
<chrname> holding up the Arc de Triomphe trophy 
every single day from now on.

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Only a trainer who believes with all their heart 
in their horsegirl's victory is a true trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
This is exactly the mindset a trainer needs 
to challenge the very summit of the world! 
I am thoroughly impressed...!!

And so the interview 
was a roaring success.
